registration_time_note: Registered before any post-trained checkpoint was scored and before any stage-1 generation. No score of this route exists at registration.

target_change.statement: The win is now measured against the POST-TRAINED Qwen3.5-0.8B, not against the Base checkpoint. Base remains a control and is never the target.
target_change.why: The post-trained checkpoint is the model a user would actually run. A route that only beats a base checkpoint has not shown a capability gain over the deployed model.

post_trained_0_8b.architecture: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration (same graph as Base: identical safetensors header, tensor names, shapes, dtypes and offsets)

auditor_certificates.kind: header, tensor table, shard hash, small-file comparison against Base
auditor_certificates.verdict: same graph, different weights; chat tokenizer adds four control tokens at 248066-248069

post_trained_0_8b.tokenizer_note: the chat tokenizer is NOT byte-identical to the Base tokenizer: it adds <tool_response>, </tool_response>, <think>, </think> at 248066-248069. Each checkpoint is prompted with its own chat template and tokenizer.

post_trained_2b.role: stage-2 teacher and stage-1 upper reference

auditor_certificates.kind: header, tensor table, shard hash, small-file comparison against 2B-Base
auditor_certificates.verdict: same graph, different weights; the same four control tokens are the only added-token difference

auditor_certificates.kind: per-tensor element accounting from safetensors headers

stage_1_measurement.purpose: measure the post-trained starting point before any distillation or looping; this stage is a measurement, not a win
stage_1_measurement.protocol: chat protocol, zero-shot chain-of-thought, final answer in \boxed{}

prompt.user_template: {question}\n\nSolve the problem step by step. Put the final answer in \boxed{}.
prompt.template: each checkpoint's own chat_template.jinja, loaded from its own revision

majority_of_16.seed_rule: torch.manual_seed(5300 + item_index) per item; vLLM sampling seed recorded per request

decoding.stop: EOS only; no string stop that could hide a thinking loop
decoding.truncation: a generation that reaches max_new_tokens is counted as answered-only-if-extractable and its truncation is reported separately

extraction.implementation: the S45 exact extractor in oracle/frontier/rft.py, unchanged
extraction.gsm8k_secondary: the last #### value; then the last number (documented fallback)
extraction.math_secondary: the last 'final answer is ...' phrase (documented fallback)
extraction.ambiguity: two distinct answers or a boxed 'or' alternative is wrong, not resolved
extraction.not_symbolic: algebraically equal but differently written answers are rejected; this is stated, not hidden

majority.tie: the earliest sample's answer wins the tie
majority.no_answer: a sample with no extractable answer does not vote

engine.why: 0.34.0 is the current release and its supported-model list names Qwen3.5; the recipe page supplies --language-model-only, --reasoning-parser qwen3 and the enable_thinking chat-template flag
engine.installation: the eval image does not contain vLLM today; stage 1 requires a new image pinning the wheel above and a receipt for the installed version. An unpinned vLLM may not produce a scored number.
engine.tokens_per_second: output tokens divided by decode wall seconds, measured per model x mode x decoding, recorded in the receipt

report_table.rows: model (post-0.8B, post-2B, base-0.8B, base-2B) x mode (thinking, non-thinking) x decoding (greedy, maj@16) x task (GSM8K, MATH-500)
report_table.no_hand_numbers: every cell is emitted from the stage-1 receipt; no number is typed into this registration or a report

stage_2_on_policy_distillation.data_selection: seeded stratified selection over source, difficulty and reasoning-length quartile (the S53 RFT amendment)

rollouts.refresh: re-sample every 1,000 optimiser steps; the actual refresh count and token count are receipted
rollouts.on_policy_note: fully online rollouts at every step are out of budget; the refresh schedule makes the mismatch explicit and measurable

objective.kl: per-token reverse KL, KL(student_T || teacher_T) at T=2.0, on the student's own rollouts
objective.reward: verified-answer reward: 1.0 when the extracted answer equals the reference answer exactly, 0.0 otherwise
objective.assembly: reward_weight * reverse_KL per rollout token; incorrect rollouts contribute zero KL weight and are reported as such
objective.no_forward_kl: the forward-KL stage-2 objective is not reused

model.active_union_basis: finetuning changes values, not identities; the deployed text tower is the full 752,393,024

optimiser.kind: adam8bit, block 256, stochastic rounding, corrected second moment
optimiser.lr_basis: the S50 KL-validated rate; a higher rate needs its own fixed-batch KL-gate receipt
optimiser.smoke: 20-step smoke per arm; container limit from its own cgroup peak (1.5x, never below +1 GiB)

win.statement: stage 2 wins iff greedy beats post-trained 0.8B on BOTH GSM8K and MATH-500 with paired 95% item-level intervals above zero
win.interval: item-level paired bootstrap 95%, 4,000 resamples, seed 53, all items in the denominator
win.no_softening: a gain on one task, a family-mean tie, or a maj@16-only gain is not the win
win.retention: MMLU and MMLU-Pro are reported against post-trained 0.8B but are not a win condition in this registration

loop.re_entry_gate: zero-initialised; the R=1 path is bit-identical to stage-2
loop.per_pass_depth_lora: one zero-initialised low-rank adapter per pass; rank and parameter count are registered before launch
loop.bit_identical_test: with the gate and every adapter at zero, the looped model's logits at R=1 must equal stage-2's logits exactly (bitwise) on a fixed batch

teacher.source: stage-2 model at R=1 (a frozen snapshot)
teacher.privileged_context: a solution that is BOTH the maj@16 consensus AND verified against the training label
teacher.student_context: the prompt only; the student never sees the privileged solution at inference
teacher.why_privileged: the teacher is a compute- and information-privileged view of the same parameters, not a larger external model

stage_3_looped_self_distillation.student_rollouts: the looped model on its own rollouts
stage_3_looped_self_distillation.objective: per-token reverse KL, KL(student_T || teacher_T) at T=2.0

win.statement: greedy R=4 beats stage-2 greedy on the paired 95% interval, and closes most of the gap to stage-2 maj@16 at a fraction of its FLOPs per answer
win.closes_most: the R=4 greedy score is at least two thirds of the way from stage-2 greedy to stage-2 maj@16 on BOTH GSM8K and MATH-500
win.flops_fraction: R=4 greedy FLOPs per answer <= 0.30 of stage-2 maj@16 FLOPs per answer
win.flops_basis: prefill + decode FLOPs from the executed set (layers, hidden width, vocabulary head, generated tokens); the Rust executed-set audit supplies the layer/parameter counts

stage_4_confirmation.audit: the Rust executed-set audit (selvedge inspect-model / executed-set report) records the parameter and FLOPs identities of every scored checkpoint
stage_4_confirmation.evaluation: greedy and maj@16 on GSM8K and MATH-500 under the identical stage-1 protocol
stage_4_confirmation.comparison: post-trained 0.8B, same protocol, same item set
stage_4_confirmation.report: per-seed scores, the seed mean and its interval, FLOPs per answer, and every truncated or unparseable answer
stage_4_confirmation.win: the seed mean preserves the stage-3 win in the same direction on both tasks, and no seed reverses it

risks_and_mitigations.risk: thinking-loop mode: the chat checkpoint can emit a long or repeated thinking block, so a score can be a truncation artefact
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: cap max_new_tokens at the registered value, report truncation and repetition separately, and never count a truncated generation as a reasoning win; the non-thinking mode is measured separately

risks_and_mitigations.risk: co-residency: the teacher and student are both resident, and a second job can OOM the first
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: one GPU job at a time; the teacher is loaded once per arm; the container limit comes from that arm's own smoke peak (1.5x, never below +1 GiB); host MemAvailable must exceed limit + 4 GiB before launch

risks_and_mitigations.risk: per-pass state: a looped model that carries convolution or cache state across passes or examples can leak one example into the next
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: reset per-pass state at every sequence boundary, test state-digest equality on repeated calls, and require the R=1 bit-identical test before any R>1 score

risks_and_mitigations.risk: contamination: the train prompts and the test items are different splits but a generated solution can reproduce a test item
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: the S45 5-word shingle Jaccard check, discard at 0.2, fail closed at 0.5, carried into every sampling and stream receipt

risks_and_mitigations.risk: formatting-versus-reasoning: a gain in \boxed{} formatting can look like a reasoning gain
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: report format-correct/answer-wrong and answer-correct-without-box separately; the win is answer exactness, and a formatting-only shift is not a win

risks_and_mitigations.risk: FLOPs: a looped model can look cheaper by parameter count while using more sequential compute per answer
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: report prefill + decode FLOPs per answer from the executed set; the R=4 win requires <= 0.30 of stage-2 maj@16 FLOPs, not a parameter-count comparison

what_this_registration_does_not_establis: that any post-trained checkpoint has been scored: stage 1 has not run

that vLLM 0.34.0 runs these exact 0.8B/2B chat checkpoints on this host: the recipe page names the 397B-A17B model and the supported-model list names Qwen3.5; a stage-1 smoke must confirm the small checkpoints before a score
that stage 2 will win: the win is the experiment
that the privileged teacher is available at inference: it is not; only the student is deployed
that the looped model is parameter-cheaper: it reuses parameters but spends more sequential compute; FLOPs are reported
that a maj@16 gain is a greedy win: stage 2 and stage 3 require the greedy comparison
that the exact extractor is symbolic: it is not, and a false reject is treated as safer than a false accept
